A named outsider can assume this role.

  Anyone                exact           No grant is placed with people who have no account anywhere.
  Anyone on a platform  exact           No grant is placed at a whole platform.
  A named outsider      exact  grant 1  github:acme and github:@123456 can assume this role and are not declared as yours.
  Your pipelines        exact           No grant is confined to owners declared as yours.
  Your people           exact           No grant trusts a SAML provider declared as yours.

Each of these can narrow the rings and was not read: the organisation's resource control policies, the calling accounts' service control policies and this account's identity providers.

grant 1 of 1 · statement[0] "GitHubWholeOrganisation" · Allow · https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com · outsider · exact
This role admits any token from token.actions.githubusercontent.com whose aud is sts.amazonaws.com, whose repository_owner_id is 123456 and whose sub matches repo:acme/*.
Who holds those identities now is not computed here: no network request is made.

CLAIM                ADMITS               IN WORDS · AS WRITTEN
aud                  "sts.amazonaws.com"  exactly this audience · line 13 StringEquals
repository_owner_id  "123456"             exactly this value · line 14 StringEquals
sub                  like:"repo:acme/*"   any subject beginning repo:acme/ · line 17 StringLike
any other claim      any                  unconstrained · no condition names it

a token this grant admits
  {
    "iss": "https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com",
    "aud": "sts.amazonaws.com",
    "sub": "repo:acme/",
    "repository_owner_id": "123456"
  }
The decoded payload. A claim not shown is unconstrained by this grant, but for azp. It sets no azp: AWS reads aud from azp whenever a token sets one.
